name: Chest-supported dumbbell reverse fly
definition: Lie chest-down on a low-incline bench with dumbbells hanging below and elbows slightly bent. Move the arms outward and back toward the torso plane, then lower.

value.movement: Move the arms outward and back toward the torso plane, then lower.
value.finish: Return to the same hanging-arm position.
